## Teaching

::: {.entry}
<div class="entry-dates">May 2022 – Aug 2023</div>
<div class="entry-body">
### ATER — Temporary Lecturer and Research Assistant
<div class="entry-org">Université Paris-Est Créteil (UPEC), France</div>
<p>Delivered undergraduate lectures and hands-on labs: core Python programming,
integration of multimodal wearable sensors (EMG, IMU, FSR), and biomechanical
signal processing with Python and MATLAB.</p>
</div>
:::
